## Education

- **PhD in Mathematics**, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, 1981
- **BA in Mathematics and Physics, summa cum laude**, Pomona College, 1977

## Experience {.career-history}

### Illinois Institute of Technology

- **Professor of Applied Mathematics**, 2005–present
- **Vice Provost for Research**, 2018–2024
- **Director of the Center for Interdisciplinary Scientific Computation**, 2017–2018
- **Department Chair of Applied Mathematics**, 2005–2017

### Hong Kong Baptist University (Hong Kong Baptist College before 1994)

- **Professor of Mathematics**, 1999–2005
- **Associate Professor of Mathematics**, 1995–1999
- **Department Head of Mathematics**, 1989–2002
- **Senior Lecturer in Mathematics**, 1987–1995
- **Lecturer in Mathematics**, 1985–1987

### University of Southern California

- **Assistant Professor of Mathematics**, 1981–1985
